scope.text: Calculus; functions defined on an interval [a,b] (integrability conditions as stated)

text: If f(x) is a function defined on an interval [a,b], the definite integral of f from a to b is the limit of a Riemann sum (when it exists), written as the integral from a to b of f(x) dx; when this limit exists f is said to be integrable on [a,b].
